thread:
bchen: quick canary note for v5.1-int4 rollout (cohort: rerank-heavy traffic). posting topline then steps.
marta: TL;DR?
bchen: p50 ~42ms, p95 ~165ms. cost ~0.38x fp16. global ndcg delta = -0.9% (n=6.2k). rerank-longtail slice delta = -2.4% (n=900), rerank-short +0.3% (n=3.5k).
qa: 900 samples on rerank-longtail is under typical per-slice min_samples 1k. would that have prevented auto-fallback?
devops-bot: Policy lookup: canary.policy.v4 -> default_slice_threshold=-0.015, global_threshold=-0.008, min_samples=1000, weighted_slice_override: {weight_cutoff:0.15, delta_cutoff:-0.01}.
marta: ah so there's a weighted override: if a slice carries >15% traffic and delta <= -1.0% absolute then trigger regardless of sample count. what's rerank-longtail weight?
bchen: rerank-longtail weight=0.18 of the canary cohort. p-value for that slice = 0.007. bootstrap CI = [-3.1%, -1.6%].
reliability: given weight>0.15 and delta -2.4% < -0.01, policy would auto-fallback. Are we seeing auto action?
devops-bot: Canary decision: auto-fallback condition met -> initiating rollback.
bchen: I didn't expect it to fire because sample<min_samples. good catch that policy has the override. Open question: is the rerank delta from quantized top-k softmax rounding?
marta: logs show topk beam distribution shifted slightly; topk-softmax quant kernel uses int4 lut approximation that was updated in this release. Could explain rerank scoring drift.
qa: can we repro locally with a rerank-heavy workload (seqlen ~160, beam=12)?
bchen: repro started: local microbench with seeded 2k rerank-longtail queries; initial run mirrors delta ~-2.1%. Looks consistent.
marta: plan: 1) pause promotion 2) confirm rollback (if not already) 3) run focused diff on top-50 failing examples to inspect score shifts 4) try fallback quant-kernel (int4-lut-v1) to isolate kernel vs quant schedule.
bchen: executing rollback: /rollout rollback --model v5.1-int4 --note "rerank-longtail weighted delta -2.4% triggered weighted-slice-override"
devops-bot: Rollout acknowledged. Routing switched to v5.0-fp16 within 90s. Canary tag paused.
qa: capture artifacts and attach: s3://redwood-evals/1798007654/v5.1-int4-rerank-smoke.jsonl and s3://redwood-logs/1798007654/rerank-traces.zip
marta: I'll run the top-50 diff and upload a mini report. also will test int4-lut-v1 to see if kernel change is root cause.
bchen: addendum: KV cache warmup rates looked normal; this appears localized to scoring kernel.
reliability: Incident INC-2026-0495 created (weighted-slice override fired). Assigned: bchen, marta. SLA: 72h.
qa: reminder: once we have a fix, run an A/B with rerank-heavy oversample (n=4k) plus shadow run for 24h before any promotion.
bchen: agreed. I'll follow up in this thread with the top-50 diff and the int4-lut comparison results. :mag:
